buyer_persona: US home-based food producer selling baked goods, jams, pickles, dry mixes, or similar allowed foods at farmers markets, roadside stands, or direct delivery, who needs a plain system to track state caps, registrations, and labels.
changelog: 1.0 - Initial release: state tracker, label checker with nine-allergen review, registration log, sales-cap tracker, label template, signage text.
disclaimer: This kit is an organizational tool only and is not legal advice. Food rules vary by state and change often, including 2025 reforms in TX, VT, IA, OK, NV, MN. Verify your state rules locally with your state health or agriculture department before producing, labeling, or selling.

faq.a: No. Rules differ by state and by food type, and allowed foods, caps, permits, and label wording vary. Use the State Requirements Tracker and verify your state rules locally.
faq.q: Does this kit cover my state?

faq.a: It includes a structured nine-allergen review plus a home-kitchen warning field, with plain steps for writing Contains statements and checking ingredient lists. It does not test food or replace label review by a qualified reviewer.

how_to_use: 1) Enter your states in the State Requirements Tracker and verify rules locally. 2) Log registrations and training certificates. 3) Build each product label with the label template and check it in the Label Compliance Checker, including the nine-allergen review. 4) Log monthly sales in the Sales Cap Tracker. 5) Print signage text for your stall or delivery bag.
limitations: State rules change frequently; figures in examples are illustrative examples only. The kit does not analyze food safety, test pH or water activity, approve labels, file permits, or provide legal advice. Some foods are not allowed under cottage rules in some states. Verify your state rules locally.
long_description: A practical record-keeping kit for cottage food operators dealing with state-by-state variance in caps, labels, and registration. Includes a state-requirements tracker, label compliance checker with nine major allergens plus home-kitchen warning, registration log, sales-cap tracker with formulas, a label template, and stall signage text. Built for steady monthly use at markets and home kitchens, with verification steps in every sheet.
name: Cottage Food Compliance Kit
outcome_statement: Designed to help you keep state requirements, label checks, registrations, and sales totals organized in one place with regular verification steps.
problem_statement: Cottage food rules vary widely by state: different sales caps, different registration steps, different label wording, plus 2025 reforms in states such as TX, VT, IA, OK, NV, and MN. Allergen labeling adds another layer, with nine major allergens to review on every product plus a home-kitchen warning in many states.
short_description: Track state rules, labels, allergens, registrations, and sales caps for home-based food sales.
support: Email support for file access and use questions. For rule questions, contact your state health or agriculture department directly.
whats_included: Workbook with 4 sheets: State Requirements Tracker, Label Compliance Checker, Registration Log, Sales Cap Tracker
3 document templates: product label, registration cover sheet, signage and customer notice
Checklists, illustrative examples labeled as such, FAQ
who_for: Home-based producers of allowed cottage foods
Producers who want structured label and allergen checks
who_not_for: Meat, dairy, or other foods requiring licensed facility production
Anyone seeking legal advice or permit filing service
